title: Patreon cut 20% of its staff. Its CEO insists AI isn’t replacing them.

content_html:
Patreon is cutting a fifth of its staff. Its founder wants you to know it is not because of AI. On Thursday the creator-payments company laid off 93 people, about 20% of its workforce, as 404 Media first reported. Chief executive Jack Conte called the day “painful” and took the blame himself.

“The people at Patreon are the core of our spirit,” he wrote. “As the person responsible for this decision, I don’t take that lightly.”

His explanation was not a business in trouble. Conte said the core was “healthy and strong”. More than 300,000 creators earn on the platform. It pays out billions a year, with steady monthly growth.

The problem, he said, was a market that had “undergone profound change over the last 6 months”. Patreon needed a leaner cost base to stay “a stable, dependable rock for our creators”.

Not because of AI

Then came the careful part. “We are not making the above changes because we believe AI replaces humans,” Conte wrote. The tools, he added, are “not substitutes for the creativity, judgment, or craftsmanship that our teammates have in spades”.

And yet a caveat follows. “AI has fundamentally transformed the tech industry,” Conte wrote. It changes “how we work, how we build products, how we communicate”, and thus “how we operate and organize”.

So AI is not taking these jobs. It is reshaping the company that cut them. Conte has been blunter about the stakes elsewhere. On the Decoder podcast, he said Patreon must embrace these tools or “be dead in three years”.

A growing business, shrinking headcount

What makes the cuts jar is the numbers around them. In April, Patreon said its podcasters alone generated $629 million in 2025, up 33% on the year. Its hosts include Quentin Tarantino, Bret Easton Ellis and Nikki Glaser.

“And it had to cut staff?? Insane,” one observer wrote. Conte’s answer is that the shift into a “media and community network” will take time, and the wait needs funding.

Departing staff get at least 16 weeks of pay, plus an extra week for every year served.

They also keep healthcare to the end of the year, and get a $1,500 laptop stipend. It is Patreon’s biggest cut since 2022, when it shed about 80 people and closed its Dublin and Berlin offices. “This change allows us to continue building from a position of strength,” Conte wrote, “no matter how the chaotic world around us changes.”

Protecting creators from the thing it is restructuring around

The move sits awkwardly beside Patreon’s public stance on AI. A week earlier, it started blocking AI crawlers from scraping creators’ work to train models. Conte announced the Cloudflare partnership in all-caps.

In March, he warned AI firms against deploying tools in a way that “just creates a bloodbath for the world’s creative people”. Internally, though, the company is embracing the same technology to move faster with fewer people. It fights AI for its creators, and leans on it for itself.

Patreon is not alone, and that is the point. Uber cut 10% of its customer-service staff the same day, also citing AI. Monday.com, Snap, Block, LinkedIn and Meta have all trimmed headcount this year against an AI backdrop.

Almost none say the machines did it. They say what Conte says. AI has changed how the work gets done, and the company must change with it. Is that a real distinction, or a softer way to say the same thing? It is the question hanging over the industry.

For the 93 people leaving Patreon, it may not feel like much of one.

content_html_zh:
Patreon 正在裁员五分之一。 它的创始人想让你知道这不是因为人工智能。 据 404 Media 最先报道，周四，这家创作者支付公司解雇了 93 名员工，约占其员工总数的 20%。 首席执行官杰克·孔特称这一天“令人痛苦”，并亲自承担了责任。

“Patreon 的员工是我们精神的核心，”他写道。 “作为这个决定的负责人，我不会掉以轻心。”

他的解释并不是生意陷入困境。 孔特表示核心“健康而强大”。 超过 300,000 名创作者在该平台上赚取收入。 它每年支付数十亿美元，并且每月稳定增长。

他说，问题在于市场“在过去六个月里经历了深刻的变化”。 Patreon 需要更精简的成本基础来保持“为我们的创作者提供稳定、可靠的基石”。

不是因为人工智能

接下来是小心的部分。 “我们不会做出上述改变，因为我们相信人工智能会取代人类，”孔特写道。 他补充说，这些工具“并不能替代我们队友所拥有的创造力、判断力或工艺”。

但还有一个警告。 “人工智能从根本上改变了科技行业，”孔特写道。 它改变了“我们的工作方式、我们的产品制造方式、我们的沟通方式”，从而改变了“我们的运营和组织方式”。

所以人工智能不会抢走这些工作。 裁员的公司正在重塑。 孔特对于其他地方的利害关系一直直言不讳。 在 Decoder 播客上，他表示 Patreon 必须接受这些工具，否则“三年内就会消亡”。

业务不断增长，员工人数不断减少

造成削减的原因是它们周围的数字。 4 月份，Patreon 表示，仅其播客在 2025 年就创造了 6.29 亿美元的收入，同比增长 33%。 其主持人包括昆汀·塔伦蒂诺、布雷特·伊斯顿·埃利斯和妮基·格拉泽。

“而且还必须裁员？？ 疯了，”一位观察家写道。 孔特的回答是，向“媒体和社区网络”的转变需要时间，而等待需要资金。

离职员工至少可获得 16 周的工资，每服务一年还可额外获得一周的工资。

他们还将医疗保健维持到年底，并获得 1,500 美元的笔记本电脑津贴。 这是 Patreon 自 2022 年以来最大规模的裁员，当时该公司裁员约 80 人，并关闭了都柏林和柏林办事处。 孔特写道：“这一变化使我们能够继续保持优势，无论我们周围的混乱世界如何变化。”

保护创作者免受其正在重组的事物的影响

此举与 Patreon 对人工智能的公开立场显得很尴尬。 一周前，它开始阻止人工智能爬虫抓取创作者的作品来训练模型。 Conte 以全大写形式宣布与 Cloudflare 合作。

今年三月，他警告人工智能公司不要以“只会为世界创意人士带来一场大屠杀”的方式部署工具。 但在内部，该公司正在采用相同的技术，以更少的人员实现更快的发展。 它为它的创造者对抗人工智能，并为自己依靠人工智能。

Patreon 并不孤单，这就是重点。 Uber 同一天也以人工智能为由裁减了 10% 的客户服务人员。 Monday.com、Snap、Block、LinkedIn 和 Meta 今年都在人工智能背景下进行了裁员。

几乎没有人说是机器做到了这一点。 他们说孔特说的。 人工智能改变了工作的完成方式，公司也必须随之改变。 这是真正的区别，还是以更温和的方式表达同一件事？ 这是困扰整个行业的问题。

对于离开 Patreon 的 93 名员工来说，这可能并不算什么。
